method: Interactive Codex in-app browser against final production frontend and real local API/worker
checks: Molecule-only selection sets declared sequence record count to zero
Each nonempty SMILES line is persisted unchanged, including leading/trailing spaces
Submitted run resolves to its backend-issued persistent identifier
Malformed compound, dummy atom and padded SMILES show no numeric fields and unsupported-input abstention
Valid ethanol and isotope-labelled ethanol display version-1.1.0 descriptors
Unsupported rule scans are absent rather than completed negative scans
Browser export equals the persisted run; input/output hashes and ordered molecular hashes agree
Reload clears the in-memory credential and shows no cached findings
Reauthentication restores the persisted corrected run
Old method-1.0.0 molecular artifact shows explicit unavailable/integrity failure without scientific fields
limitations: Public synthetic software fixtures only. This manual test is not an extra automated-test count or scientific validation. No historical artifact or provenance was rewritten.
